verdict.rationale: Pilot delivers monthly books directly in QuickBooks Online, a widely-used open accounting format, and lets customers keep historical QuickBooks data if switching providers, implying some data portability — but there is no explicit documentation of a full data export feature or guarantee that all financial records/data can be exported and taken elsewhere. missing for 10: explicit export-all-data feature, documentation of open format guarantees beyond QuickBooks sync, and any independent confirmation of clean data portability upon leaving.
